project.description: Build an 8-bit replay sample host/fabric shell as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t8_replay_sample_shell, difficulty tier T8. Use host_sample_stage feeding replay_store, then sample_pack_core and sample_read_stage, with occupancy_counter status. The design must implement this black-box behavior: host-side transition samples are staged into a small replay store, then read back in FIFO order through a fabric-side valid-ready sample output with occupancy reporting. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.host_valid -> host_sample_stage.in_valid; top.host_state -> host_sample_stage.state; top.host_action -> host_sample_stage.action; top.host_reward -> host_sample_stage.reward; top.host_next_state -> host_sample_stage.next_state; top.host_done -> host_sample_stage.done; host_sample_stage.in_ready -> top.host_ready; host_sample_stage.out_valid -> replay_store.write_valid; host_sample_stage.state_out -> replay_store.write_state; host_sample_stage.action_out -> replay_store.write_action; host_sample_stage.reward_out -> replay_store.write_reward; host_sample_stage.next_state_out -> replay_store.write_next_state; host_sample_stage.done_out -> replay_store.write_done; replay_store.write_ready -> host_sample_stage.out_ready; top.sample_ready -> sample_read_stage.out_ready; sample_read_stage.read_ready -> replay_store.read_ready; replay_store.read_valid -> sample_read_stage.in_valid; replay_store.read_state -> sample_pack_core.state; replay_store.read_action -> sample_pack_core.action; replay_store.read_reward -> sample_pack_core.reward; replay_store.read_next_state -> sample_pack_core.next_state; replay_store.read_done -> sample_pack_core.done; sample_pack_core.sample_state -> sample_read_stage.sample_state; sample_pack_core.sample_action -> sample_read_stage.sample_action; sample_pack_core.sample_reward -> sample_read_stage.sample_reward; sample_pack_core.sample_next_state -> sample_read_stage.sample_next_state; sample_pack_core.sample_done -> sample_read_stage.sample_done; sample_read_stage.out_valid -> top.sample_valid; sample_read_stage.sample_state_out -> top.sample_state; sample_read_stage.sample_action_out -> top.sample_action; sample_read_stage.sample_reward_out -> top.sample_reward; sample_read_stage.sample_next_state_out -> top.sample_next_state; sample_read_stage.sample_done_out -> top.sample_done; replay_store.occupancy -> occupancy_counter.occupancy_in; occupancy_counter.occupancy_out -> top.occupancy. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
